senses.gloss: roller, a slab for rolling over a plastered roof, v. מַחֲלָץ.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 2:1">Macc. II, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Makkot 2:3">Tosef. ib. II, 3</cite>; Y. ib. II, beg. 31ᶜ.
<cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 1:10">M. Kat. I, 10</cite> <he>במ׳ ביד וברגל</he>, expl.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 11a:8">ib. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>כעין מ׳ וכ׳</he> with hands and feet as with a roller.
